speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the nature of your vertigo, specifically whether the room feels like it is spinning around you or if you feel like you are spinning yourself?

speaker: Patient
text: It definitely felt like the room was spinning around me. It was a very sudden onset that lasted for about three minutes before I started feeling nauseous and vomiting. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Dix-Hallpike maneuver Given the brief duration of spinning vertigo and associated nausea, I need to check for positional triggers to rule out Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). Please lie back quickly with your head turned to the side as I guide you through this test.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Positive, inducing nystagmus and reproducing patient’s symptoms of vertigo when head is turned to the left and laid back.

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive Dix-Hallpike maneuver confirms Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)
